title: Survey: 53.5% of Filipinos trust Senate to be fair as impeachment court
summary: MANILA, Philippines — About 53 percent of Filipinos expressed confidence that the Senate, sitting as an impeachment court, will conduct fair proceedings, according to an August 2026 national survey…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — About 53 percent of Filipinos expressed confidence that the Senate, sitting as an impeachment court, will conduct fair proceedings, according to an August 2026 national survey by Momentum Research. According to the survey, of the 1,487 Filipinos surveyed, 40.4 percent are confident and 13.1 percent are very confident that the impeachment court will be impartial in judging the case of Vice President Sara Duterte. Meanwhile, 28 percent have low confidence and 5.4 percent have very low confidence in the court. Another 9.7 percent were not sure, while 3.4 percent refused to answer.
